name: Qualys — Assets
description: Pull host inventory from Qualys VMDR (IPs, DNS, NetBIOS, OS, tracking method, AWS/Azure/GCP tags, tags)

steps.instruction: Log into Qualys as an administrator
Go to Subscription → Users → Your User → API credentials

validation_request.error_message: Could not authenticate. Check your credentials.

transform.expr: {'ip': record.get('IP', ''), 'hostname': record.get('NETBIOS', '') or record.get('DNS', ''), 'fqdn': record.get('DNS', ''), 'device_id': value, 'display_name': record.get('DNS') or record.get('NETBIOS') or record.get('IP', '')}

{'tracking_method': record.get('TRACKING_METHOD', ''), 'qg_hostid': record.get('QG_HOSTID', ''), 'last_vm_scanned_date': record.get('LAST_VM_SCANNED_DATE', ''), 'last_vm_auth_scanned_date': record.get('LAST_VM_AUTH_SCANNED_DATE', ''), 'last_compliance_scanned_date': record.get('LAST_COMPLIANCE_SCAN_DATETIME', ''), 'cloud_provider': record.get('CLOUD_PROVIDER', ''), 'cloud_service': record.get('CLOUD_SERVICE', ''), 'cloud_resource_id': record.get('CLOUD_RESOURCE_ID', ''), 'asset_group_ids': (record.get('ASSET_GROUP_IDS') or '').split(',') if record.get('ASSET_GROUP_IDS') else [], 'tags': [(t.get('TAG') or {}).get('NAME', '') for t in ((record.get('TAGS') or {}).get('TAG') or []) if isinstance(t, dict)] if isinstance(record.get('TAGS'), dict) else [], 'network_id': record.get('NETWORK_ID', '')}

vm_scan_date_after.description: Only include hosts scanned after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)
